events.note:
Juliusz Zellmer was a German soldier who was killed in action in Matrenovka, Oryol Oblast on September 9, 1943. He held the rank of Gefreiter (Private) in Grenadier-Regiment 589 as part of the XI Armeekorps of the Wehrmacht.

On May 20, 1943, Matrenovka was completely burned by the German invaders for assisting the partisans (243 people died). In 1951, a monument was erected to the victims of this tragedy. (Source https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B0%D1%82%D1%80%D1%91%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%BA%D0%B0_%28%D0%91%D1%80%D1%8F%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%BE%D0%B1%D0%BB%D0%B0%D1%81%D1%82%D1%8C%29)

Grenadier-Regiment 589 was created on October 15, 1942 by renaming the 589th Infantry Regiment and was subordinated to the 321st Infantry Division. On November 2, 1943, the regiment was disbanded and the remainder went to Regimentsgruppe 589.

A Russian Army map from 1943 shows Matrenovka circled in red alongside Kasilovo with the number "283." (Source: https://pamyat-naroda.ru/documents/view/?id=100899201&backurl=division%5C3%20%D0%90::begin_date%5C10.09.1943::end_date%5C20.09.1943::use_main_string%5Ctrue::group%5Cmap::types%5Ckarti:shemi)
